title: Forever Settled
story:
A young man once started building a house.

He first tested the ground.

Some places were soft.

Some were unstable.

He knew that if the foundation was weak, the house would fall.

So he searched carefully.

Finally, he found solid rock.

He built his house there.

Years passed.

Storms came.

Heavy rain fell.

Strong winds hit the house.

But it stood firm.

Because the foundation was unshakable.

In life, everything changes.

Opinions change.

People change.

Circumstances change.

But God’s word does not change.

It is not affected by time.

Not shaken by events.

Not broken by storms.

It remains forever.

And those who build their life on it remain strong.
life_lesson:
God’s word is unchanging and eternal.

Build your life on what never changes.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You that Your word is eternal.

Help me to trust what You have spoken.

Teach me to build my life on Your truth.

When everything around me changes, keep me steady in You.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
What are you building your life on today?

Are you trusting things that can change or God’s eternal word?

How can you strengthen your foundation in Him?
verse:
Your word, O Lord, is eternal.
It stands firm in the heavens.
